verdict: Purchases collapsed this week; creative fatigue is confirmed and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads delivered 32 purchases and a 5.06 return on ad spend, but the final three days of this week (Jul 28–30) produced zero purchases and zero revenue — a confirmed drop, not a one-day blip. The subscription box campaign absorbed more than half of total spend ($775.69 of $1,448.90) and has stopped converting, a clear sign of audience saturation or creative fatigue. At the same time, Google Business Profile engagement went dark on Jul 29–30 after averaging roughly 19 actions per day for most of the period, and Instagram reach declined a further 8.6% week-over-week, compounding the pressure. The subscription campaign is being paused and ad creative is being refreshed this week; next period you should see spend redirected toward higher-converting activity and a stabilisation in purchase numbers.

watch_item.fix: The campaign is being paused and ad creative is being replaced this week to stop the spend-to-zero situation before it carries further into next period.
